NOT a layout gap. SPOT_ADVANCED_ORDERS_ENABLED is false because the chain half is unconfirmed: skai-rpc grows the place body 126 to 159 bytes to carry triggerPrice, but SKAI_ADVANCED_ORDERS_TX defaults false on the node and a gated-off node truncates the trailing 33 bytes and rests the order as a plain limit - silently. The Pro menu 7761-224662 still lists the row (Trigger y8 h30 of a 137x122 panel) and says so per row, so the affordance is honest. Reachability verified by reading the flag, not by placing an order: localhost cannot execute a trade. Unblocks when the env is confirmed ON fleet-wide.

Same gate as Trigger above - TP/SL needs the same chain-side trigger encoding. Frame's menu row is 7761-224665 (TP/SL, y46 h30). Time-in-force is a second, independent block: CreateOrderRequest carries it but the payload posted to callSpotOrderProxy('place') never includes it, so a Fill or Kill would silently be GTC. Both must close before the flag flips.

Frame geometry NOT measured this run. What is verified is the component's contract, which is the part the no-mock policy turns on: four explicit variants (loading / empty / offline / stalled) with stalled kept distinct because the RPC ANSWERED and the head is frozen - empty would claim no quotes and offline would claim we could not reach anything, and both would be false. Only offline offers Retry, because a re-fetch cannot unfreeze a head.
